# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the `main` branch is supported. Security fixes are made on `main` and
included in the next release; they are generally not backported to older
releases. Please check whether you can reproduce the issue on `main` before
reporting.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public issues,
discussions, or pull requests.

Instead, report them privately through GitHub: open the **Security** tab of
this repository and click **Report a vulnerability**. If you cannot use
GitHub, you can also send an email to [me@crudolph.io](mailto:me@crudolph.io).

Please include:

- A description of the issue and its potential impact
- The affected version or commit
- Steps or a minimal code example to reproduce the issue

## What to Expect

This is a side project maintained in my spare time, so I cannot commit to a
specific response time, but every report will be read and taken seriously.
Once a fix is available, the issue will be disclosed via a GitHub Security
Advisory, and reporters will be credited unless they prefer otherwise.
